issue.message: Browse projects lists projects that can grow but has no search or filters. Fix: Give F16 search or filters for the growing projects list (e.g. search by name/client) with fields, or add an assumption that justifies why none is needed.

entries.reason: Added FD35 Search projects and updated F16 to offer search by name or client name.

issue.message: Designer account skip uses 'no screen in MVP' which is 'Not needed for the MVP' and holds no valid reason. Fix: Add an account flow for the designer to see and change their email/password, or replace the skip with a reason grounded in the idea or scope ruling it out.

entries.reason: Added F38 Manage account for the designer to see and change email and password and removed the designer account skip.

issue.message: Availability is used to generate Slots but is never created by a flow and no assumption says where it comes from. Fix: Add an assumption that weekly Availability is pre-created at sign-up (empty or default) and managed only in F25, or add a create flow for it.

entries.reason: Added A11 that weekly Availability is pre-created empty at sign-up and managed only in F25, and updated F02 to mention it.

issue.message: All Availability fields are required, so empty availability cannot be saved, contradicting A11 and the rule that without hours no slots are offered. Fix: Make Days (FD19), From time (FD20) and To time (FD21) required false so the designer can keep weekly Availability empty with no days/hours and offer no slots per A11.

entries.reason: Made FD19 Days, FD20 From time and FD21 To time required false so empty Availability can be saved with no slots offered per A11.
